links.comparator_used: Ungated model: raw detect-then-grade output without the cancer-tissue-fraction threshold gate
links.outcome: All-slide ISUP grading agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa) across three scanners
links.effect: Gated pipeline at 95% sensitivity operating point: cross-validated all-slide QWK 0.86, 0.81, 0.86 (Grundium, Hamamatsu, Leica), vs 0.23 to 0.62 for the ungated model; inter-pathologist ceiling 0.81
links.quote: At a 95% sensitivity operating point the deployed pipeline reached cross-validated all-slide QWK of 0.86, 0.81, and 0.86 (Grundium, Hamamatsu, Leica), matching the inter-pathologist ceiling of 0.81, against 0.23 to 0.62 for the ungated model.

design_hint: local external validation per scanner and population with detect-then-grade gating
